strongest_angle: The prosecution at Southwark Crown Court is framing Russell Brand as a calculated, ruthless predator, centering their case on the independent testimonies of six separate women.

key_facts.fact: Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC opened the case at Southwark Crown Court by describing 51-year-old Russell Brand as a ruthless and calculating sexual predator.
The legal proceedings involve allegations from six women who the prosecution states have never met each other and came forward independently.
Russell Brand faces a total of seven criminal charges, specifically three counts of rape and four counts of sexual assault.

quotes.text: Riel Karmy-Jones KC, for the prosecution, told Southwark Crown Court in London the women did not know each other, have never met each other and came forward independently of each other.
quotes.speaker: Riel Karmy-Jones KC
